title: Numbers and time
intro: Counting, prices, telling the time (watch out for half!) and dates.

topics.title: Numbers
topics.summary: eenentwintig: the unit comes first. Ordinals: eerste, tweede, derde.

body.p: Tens: 30 dertig, 40 **veertig**, 50 vijftig, 60 zestig, 70 zeventig, 80 **tachtig**, 90 negentig, 100 honderd, 1000 duizend.
From 21: **unit + en + ten**, written as one word: 21 **eenentwintig**, 35 **vijfendertig**. Use **ë** after e: 22 **tweeëntwintig**, 23 **drieëntwintig**.
Prices: €2,50 = **twee euro vijftig**. Dutch writes a decimal **comma**. Years: 1998 = negentienhonderdachtennegentig; 2026 = tweeduizendzesentwintig.
**eerste, tweede, derde, vierde, vijfde, zesde, zevende, achtste, negende, tiende** … up to 19 **-de**; from 20 **-ste**: twintig**ste**, honderd**ste**.

mistakes.why: Unit first, with en, one word.

exercises.q: Mijn verjaardag is op de ___ (3rd) mei.

topics.title: Telling the time and dates

body.tip: **half** always points to the **next** hour: half vier = 3:30, half acht = 7:30.

body.p: At a time: **om** drie uur. Officially (trains, appointments) people also say **15.30 uur**: vijftien uur dertig.
Days and months have **no capital**: maandag, dinsdag, woensdag, donderdag, vrijdag, zaterdag, zondag; januari … december.
Dates: **op** 5 mei; Het is vandaag 21 oktober. Written: 21-10-2026 (day first).

mistakes.why: half points to the next hour.

mistakes.wrong: Maandag (in the middle of a sentence)
mistakes.why: No capital for days and months.

exercises.why: half points to the next hour.

write: Write your daily schedule with times (om half acht …).
